title: Never size fixed guest RAM > host RAM minus QEMU+PVE overhead (~2.5G)
description: Comment-only doc change in k8s/charts/crossplane-proxmox/values.yaml near memoryMiB: document the sizing invariant the 2026-09-20 assumption violated — fixed guest RAM must leave headroom for QEMU+PVE overhead on the host, else the start wedges the host (this incident). Prevents re-committing the same overcommit.
notes: RAM-sizing comment already landed with fix commit 2d266077 (values.yaml line 102: 12GiB fixed vs 15.6GiB host); nothing further to change
acceptance_criteria: values.yaml comment describing the invariant merged via git.
